subject: pri-info
title: PRI.INFO.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in T(IMP)M-39, on the page where Braxton argues about 'applied definitions' — 'what a given definition used to mean in its source-initiation context, and what the same definition means after its adoption into the throngs of western dynamics. For every aspect of black methodology has had to necessarily be re-aligned to become real to western functionalism.' PRI-INFO (principle information) is crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what principle-information produces when crossed with affinity-dynamics, in a culture where applied-definitions systematically realign black methodology to western functionalism. INFO-DE-B (information degree basis) branches up to the right from the main line; it carries IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis), which carries PER-DY (perception dynamics). RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) branches to the lower left and carries SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). ALT-F (alternative functionalism) branches downward and carries EXP-DY (expansion dynamics), which carries POST (postulation), and LG-DY (logical dynamics), which carries APL-DY.
